newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Temporary staff companies started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Temporary staff companies started.

text.p: Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc on Thursday said analyst Theresa Matacia started coverage of three temporary staffing companies with buy-focus or buy-market-outperformer ratings.

--Robert Half International was initiated with a buy-focus rating. Matacia said the recommendation reflected Robert Half's market dominance in specialty staffing, debt-free balance sheet and earnings growth potential of 25 percent to 30 percent over the next three to five years.
--Robert Half shares were up 3/8 to 43-3/4 early Thursday afternoon.
--Personnel Group of America was started with a buy-market-outperformer rating. Rauscher estimated its long-term growth rate at 20 percent to 25 percent.
--Source Services Corp was also started with a buy-market-outperformer rating. Rauscher sees a 12-month to 18-month price target of $25 on the shares.
